description: Monthly revenue of one Taiwan-listed company (TWSE or TPEx), newest month first: revenue, the previous month and the same month a year earlier, month-over-month, year-over-year and year-to-date changes, and company_note, the company's own explanation of the change (Traditional Chinese). Taiwanese companies report revenue every month, by the 10th of the following month; data starts in January 2013. The percentages are reported by the company through MOPS, not calculated by Livermore. ETFs and other securities have none (empty months with a note). Follow up with tw_get_financials for quarterly statements. Taiwan conventions: money is in New Taiwan dollars (currency TWD), share counts are in shares (1 lot = 1,000 shares), prices are in TWD and fields ending in _pct are percentages (12.5 means 12.5%). market is TWSE (listed) or TPEx (OTC). Names are in Traditional Chinese, with name_en where available. url links to tw.livermore.club, whose pages are in Traditional Chinese only. Keep `attribution` when you present the data: Taiwan's Open Government Data License requires naming its sources, and fields listed in computed_by_livermore are Livermore's calculations, not official figures.

code.description: Taiwan stock code, e.g. 2330 (TSMC), 0050 (an ETF) or 00981A. Lowercase, 2330.TW and 2330.TWO also work. Use tw_search to find a code by company name.

months.description: Number of months, newest first (1-200, default 24). Data starts in January 2013.

name: tw_get_monthly_revenue

attribution.description: Required attribution: Taiwan's Open Government Data License requires naming the sources when you present or pass on this data, and Livermore's own calculations must be kept apart from the official figures.

computed_by_livermore.description: Fields calculated by Livermore from the official data (not published by the sources). Present them as Livermore's calculations, apart from the official figures.

license.description: The license of the data from `sources`; null when no such data was used.

other_sources.description: Sources that are not government open data and not under the license (industry chains).

sources.description: The government open data providers whose data this result uses.

available_months.description: Months of revenue Livermore has for this company.

currency.description: Every amount of money in this result is in New Taiwan dollars (TWD).

market.description: TWSE = listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange; TPEx = traded on the Taipei Exchange (OTC market).

company_note.description: The company's explanation of the change, in Traditional Chinese; null when none.

mom_pct.description: Change from the previous month (%), as reported by the company.

revenue_last_year.description: Revenue in the same month a year earlier.

yoy_pct.description: Change from the same month a year earlier (%), as reported.

ytd.description: Revenue from January through this month.

name_en.description: English short name (for example TSMC); null when there is none.

url.description: The revenue page on tw.livermore.club (Traditional Chinese).

title: Taiwan stock: monthly revenue
